summary: This document defines the TimetableRotation class and its related methods used for handling timetable rotations in an educational booking system. It includes functionalities for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting timetable rotations based on various criteria. Business logic is applied to ensure dates fall within permissible ranges.
purpose: To manage and manipulate timetable rotations, ensuring they adhere to defined business rules and date validations within an educational system's scheduling component.

workflows.name: Update TimetableRotation
steps: Check if ID is not zero and Validate with IsValid

workflows.name: Delete TimetableRotation
steps: Check if ID is not zero

validations: StartDate must not be after EndDate
Dates must not be before TimetableStartDate
Dates must not be after TimetableEndDate
system_behavior: Adds a new rotation if dates are valid
Updates an existing rotation if dates are valid
Deletes a rotation if ID is specified
